final_takeaways: Nothing in this delta is authoritative. Every item is a candidate for librarian review.
30 candidate decisions, 15 open questions, 6 action items, 12 items deliberately not promoted.
The decision registry is empty, so no candidate could cite a supersedes_id. Nothing in this source reverses a recorded decision.
Almost every call in this source is spoken by the shared boardroom microphone, so owner is "unknown" on all but one candidate and confidence is capped at medium accordingly.
Six candidates are low confidence and need a close look: CAND-DEC-011, CAND-DEC-015, CAND-DEC-026, CAND-DEC-027, CAND-DEC-029, CAND-DEC-030.
Several MVP-critical inputs remain undefined: approval score thresholds, the network rule book, and Infinant API availability.
blocking_reasons: All candidates require librarian approval before any record or ticket can be created.
CAND-Q-001 (approval score thresholds) and CAND-Q-015 (the network rule book does not yet exist) gate the decisioning and rule-book candidates.
